fact: Community health workers in the health districts of Diéma, Kita, Sikasso and Kignan reported births and perinatal deaths by smartphone into DHIS2 over eight months (729 live births, 35 perinatal deaths), via the DISK-Mali tool that the abstract says is integrated into DHIS2, per INSP and Vital Strategies.
Muso describes DHIS2 as the official national health data management system of Mali, and a DGSHP deputy director says interoperability between DHIS2 and DISC-Mali has been established.
The IJRIAS abstract says DHIS2 is implemented in Mali for service delivery, monitoring and evaluation of health programmes, based on a survey run September 2023 to September 2024.
The source calls DHIS2 Mali's national health information system, to which community health centres, reference health centres and hospitals submit routine data.
